annotations.title: Read the text in an image

description: OCR: read the text in an image. Give the image as a URL. Returns every text region with its text, confidence, bounding box and polygon. Reads Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, English and other Latin-script text. One credit per image; an image whose long side is 2.5 times its short side or more is read in sections, one credit each.

image_url.description: An http(s) URL of a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.

language.description: auto (default) returns all the text; another value returns only the text in that language.
